page.content:
Long-necked, pillar-limbed giants of the Jurassic and Cretaceous.

How Sauropoda connects

  • Topic: Saurischia — Sauropods are the long-necked giants inside Saurischia.
  • Weapon: Diplodocus — Diplodocus is a slender Morrison sauropod.
  • Item: Brachiosaurus — Brachiosaurus is a high-shouldered Morrison sauropod.

What is Sauropoda?

Sauropoda includes Diplodocus, Brachiosaurus, and their kin — the largest land animals, abundant in the Morrison Formation and later southern continents.

Key threads lead to Saurischia, Diplodocus and Brachiosaurus.
